# Caleb (Kwan Ho) Leung

> Recruiter-focused guide to Caleb Leung's software-engineering portfolio.

## Primary professional takeaway

Caleb is a software engineer specializing in AI document processing, retrieval systems, backend engineering, distributed processing, and reliable data pipelines.

## Core ownership at IntellPro

- Caleb owns the distributed embedding stage, including its rate limiting, retries, worker orchestration, concurrency control, dead-letter queue handling, and state-machine-based job coordination.
- Caleb built the text-extraction service and designed scalable document-transformation services.
- Caleb designed and developed a custom financial-document chunking algorithm and supporting library that replaced the prior LangChain-based chunking implementation.

## Scope of the broader pipeline

The systems above are Caleb's owned components within a broader, team-built production document-processing pipeline. Caleb contributes to that pipeline but does not claim end-to-end ownership of it. It handles approximately 3,000 documents per day across more than 10 integrations.
